note: Build-time only. Takes are auditioned from tmp/sfx/ and the winner is promoted by hand to public/assets/sfx/. The kiosk never calls this API.

defaults.negative: no music, no voice, no room reverb, no background ambience, no birdsong

shutter.label: Camera shutter
shutter.hook: flash() in public/index.html — must land on the same frame as the white flash

takes.text: one single crisp mechanical camera shutter click, leaf shutter snap, dry and close-miked, tight transient, silence before and after
vintage instant camera shutter: a short spring-loaded clack with a faint metallic ring, recorded dry in a treated booth, one shot only
soft plastic toy-camera shutter click, light and friendly, low mechanical mass, single click, no tail

count.label: Countdown beep
count.hook: setCount() in frame() — fires on 3 and on 2

takes.text: a single short electronic countdown beep, clean sine tone, mid pitch, 100 milliseconds, dry studio recording, no reverb, absolute silence before and after
one crisp digital timer pip, pure tone, brief and neutral, like a broadcast countdown clock, no echo

count_go.label: Countdown final beep
count_go.hook: the 1 — higher and longer, so the guest knows the shutter is next

takes.text: a single higher-pitched electronic beep, clean sine tone, slightly longer than a countdown pip, resolving upward, dry, no reverb

tap.label: Selection tap
tap.hook: renderFrames / renderFilterGrid / renderStickers — the most frequent sound in the booth, easily 40x a session

takes.text: one very short muted wooden tick, like a fingernail on a hollow bamboo block, tiny and dry, no pitch, no tail, absolute silence after
a single soft rubber dome keyswitch press, muffled and low, close-miked, one press only, no release click

place.label: Sticker placed
place.hook: startDrag release — the guest has committed something to the photo, so it gets more body than a tap

takes.text: a soft felt thunk of a rubber stamp pressed onto thick paper, low and padded, brief, no reverb
a small sticker being pressed flat onto glossy card, a short tacky adhesive press, close and intimate

confirm.label: Step advance
confirm.hook: show() when moving forward a step — once per screen, so it can afford to be pitched and pleasant

takes.text: two soft mallet notes rising a fourth on a small wooden marimba, warm and dry, gentle, fading quickly
a single bright glass bell ping, short and clean, rising in brightness, no long shimmer tail

back.label: Step back
back.hook: the back control — the mirror of confirm, and must not sound like an error

takes.text: two soft mallet notes falling a fourth on a small wooden marimba, warm and dry, gentle, unhurried, not sad

eject.label: Print eject motor
eject.hook: startPrint() in public/index.html — loops under the 3.2s eject window

takes.text: instant film printer ejecting a photo: small DC motor whirr with rollers gripping and feeding stiff film, steady mid-pitch hum, mechanical, close-miked
polaroid camera motor drive pushing film out through rollers, gritty geared whirr that slows slightly at the end, dry and mechanical
quiet servo whirr of a photo printer feeding paper, smooth and continuous, gentle, unobtrusive at low volume
